name: Yardi
description: Connect your own Yardi Voyager Standard Interfaces (Common Data, Billing & Payments, Vendor Invoicing, Service Requests, Revenue Management, Lease Renewals, ILS/Guest Card) -- read and write properties, units, residents, leases, charges, payments, vendors, payables, purchase orders, budgets, maintenance work orders, lease renewals, and prospect/guest card data across your property management portfolio.

tools.name: connect_yardi
tools.description: Connect one of your own Yardi Voyager Standard Interfaces (Common Data, Billing & Payments, Vendor Invoicing, Service Requests, Revenue Management, Lease Renewals, or ILS/Guest Card) by saving its WSDL URL and Login-block credentials, after checking it actually works.

wsdl_url.description: Full WSDL URL for this interface, e.g. https://www.yardiasp13.com/yourclient/webservices/ItfCommonData.asmx?WSDL
wsdl_url.title: Wsdl Url

interface.description: Which Yardi Standard Interface this WSDL belongs to: common_data, billing_and_payments, vendor_invoicing, service_requests, revenue_management, lease_renewals, or ils_guest_card.
interface.title: Interface

username.description: Yardi Voyager UserName for this interface's Login block.
username.title: Username

password.description: Yardi Voyager Password for this interface's Login block.
password.title: Password

server_name.description: Yardi ServerName (from Voyager Administration > About > URL).
server_name.title: Server Name

database.description: Yardi Database name for this Voyager instance.
database.title: Database

platform.description: Yardi Platform value (as issued by your Yardi representative).
platform.title: Platform

interface_entity.description: Yardi InterfaceEntity value for this interface license.
interface_entity.title: Interface Entity

interface_license.description: Yardi InterfaceLicense key issued for this specific interface.
interface_license.title: Interface License

label.description: Optional friendly name for this interface connection, e.g. 'Acme Portfolio - Billing'.
label.title: Label

tools.description: List your saved Yardi Voyager interface connections.

params_schema.description: Explicit empty params model -- V17 disallows untyped handlers.
params_schema.title: NoParams

tools.name: call_yardi_operation
tools.description: Call ANY SOAP operation on a connected Yardi interface by its exact name (e.g. GetResidents, ImportCharge_Login, GetPurchaseOrders) -- full coverage beyond the curated wrapper functions, for operations not yet given their own dedicated tool.

connection_id.description: ID of the Yardi interface connection to use. Omit to use the only/most recent one for that interface.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

operation.description: Exact SOAP operation name to call, e.g. GetResidents, ImportCharge_Login, GetPurchaseOrders.
operation.title: Operation

parameters_json.description: JSON object of the operation's own parameters (excluding the Login block, which is added automatically), e.g. {"YardiPropertyId": "123", "FromDate": "2026-01-01"}.
parameters_json.title: Parameters Json

tools.name: list_yardi_wsdl_operations
tools.description: Introspect a connected Yardi interface's own WSDL and list every SOAP operation it actually exposes -- use this to discover exact operation names before calling call_yardi_operation, since licensed operation sets can differ between Voyager deployments.

connection_id.description: ID of the Yardi interface connection whose WSDL to introspect.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

tools.name: audit_yardi_properties
tools.description: Value-add report: scan every property visible to this Yardi Common Data connection and flag data-quality issues -- properties missing a name, missing an address, or with obviously malformed ids. Not a native Yardi operation.

connection_id.description: ID of the Common Data interface connection to audit.
connection_id.title: Connection Id

secrets.name: yardi_connections
secrets.description: Saved Yardi Voyager interface connections -- stored as a JSON array, one entry per connected Standard Interface, each with its own WSDL URL and Login-block credentials (UserName, Password, ServerName, Database, Platform, InterfaceEntity, InterfaceLicense) and a label. Managed through connect_yardi / disconnect_yardi -- you should not need to edit this directly.
